metadata.title: This Week, Gordy.
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Jambo (Swahili), one word — fresh for this channel (Namaste, Kumusta, Sawubona, Hej and Merhaba are spent on the five prior reels). Yatra on her OWN channel (@Yatra), so IN-FOR-BEAR LAW does not apply. Voice: Kokoro af_bella.
metadata.color_semantics: Fidelity claude palette. ONE terracotta #D97757 event per beat, and it always marks THE UNCLOSED STAGE — the work that is not finished. The accent carries the reel's whole point (an honest week, not a finished one) rather than decorating the frame. Citations and provenance stay muted ink.
metadata.note: ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open with RESULT lines), B04 (ask micro-beat of the one ask→result pair, resolved by B05), B09 (verdict artifact), B10 (handoff), B11 (outro). Every other beat illustrates with a purpose-built scene. HONESTY (hard, per the human): the two articles are IN REVIEW, not published — no title, summary or content may reach the screen, and WkReview has no prop that could carry one. Gordy's description is rendered VERBATIM from its tool page and the reel states on screen that one line is the whole public description. No count of graphics; no claim they are live. See FACTCHECK.md.
metadata.reformat: center-cut, focus-aware; pantry/<bid>-916.* is the human replacement slot; -916 overrides honored

beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Yatra. This is the weekly recap — one tool from Humanitarians AI, used properly, then written up. This week the tool was Gordy, and one part of the work is still sitting in review.

show.event: Cream page, serif greeting 'Jambo, Yatra' above the composer
The ask types itself in
Terracotta send arms — the ONE accent
Three result lines stagger in; the third names the unclosed stage — the ask lands ANSWERED

props.command: Recap my week on the Humanitarians AI tool series. This week's tool was Gordy. Show what I finished, what I shipped, and what is still waiting on approval — and do not claim anything is published that isn't.
output: tool used: Gordy — experimented with it properly
made: graphics for the Humanitarians AI LinkedIn page
in review with Nina: 2 articles → Substack once approved

beats.narration_text: The series runs on a fixed method, and it matters for what follows. Pick one tool. Use it for real. Make something with it. Write it up. Publish. Five stages — and a week can end mid-pipeline.

URL sets in mono, then the source line — held ≥2s

beats.narration_text: Then the writing. Two articles about Gordy, both finished, both currently with Nina for review. When they are approved they go up on Substack. Not published yet — so I am not going to describe them.
